# BTechX
> A free, comprehensive academic resource and structured notes platform for B.Tech engineering students.

## Subjects & Notes
Provides structured curriculum notes, syllabi, and downloadable PDFs for engineering students.
- [Engineering Mathematics 1](https://btechx.infinityfreeapp.com/1stYearSub/math1.html): Differential calculus, multivariable functions, and vector calculus notes.
- [Engineering Mathematics 2](https://btechx.infinityfreeapp.com/1stYearSub/math2.html): Linear algebra, differential equations, and complex analysis.
- [Engineering Physics](https://btechx.infinityfreeapp.com/1stYearSub/physics.html): Quantum mechanics, optics, and solid-state physics theory.
- [Programming for Problem Solving (CSE)](https://btechx.infinityfreeapp.com/1stYearSub/cse.html): C programming fundamentals and data structures.
- [Basic Electrical Engineering (BEE)](https://btechx.infinityfreeapp.com/1stYearSub/bee.html): AC/DC circuits, transformers, and electrical machines.
- [Basic Electronics Engineering (IEE)](https://btechx.infinityfreeapp.com/1stYearSub/iee.html): Semiconductors, diodes, transistors, and logic gates.
- [Engineering Mechanics (IME)](https://btechx.infinityfreeapp.com/1stYearSub/ime.html): Statics, dynamics, and structural analysis principles.
- [Discrete Mathematics & Graph Theory (DMGT)](https://btechx.infinityfreeapp.com/2ndYearSub/dmgt.html): Logic, set theory, combinatorics, and graph algorithms.

## Apps & AI Tools
- [Apps & AI Tools](https://btechx.infinityfreeapp.com/apps.html): Innovative web apps and AI tools built by DLM for engineering students.

## Resources
- [Syllabus Tracker](https://btechx.infinityfreeapp.com/syllabus.html): Complete semester-wise engineering syllabus mapping.
- [About & Contact](https://btechx.infinityfreeapp.com/about.html): Information about the BTechX platform and developer team.
